data.name: Mumina
data.gender_notes: Mumina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'm-m-n' meaning to believe, trust. In Islam, this name signifies a person of strong faith, who believes and trusts in Allah. The name Mumina carries the meaning “Faithful, Believer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mumina usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, believer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes faith, trust, and submission to Allah.
data.etymology: Mumina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful, Believer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mumina total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
